text:
Platinum Price in 2014
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2014, the LBMA platinum price fell 12.7% between 2014-01-31 ($1,382) and 2014-12-30 ($1,206). The highest sampled price was $1,480 in June and the lowest was $1,205 in November. The mean of these observations was $1,371. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
